title: Austin's Internal Workings & Public Outreach
meeting_type: Council Transition Work Group Regular Meeting
summary:
*   **Streamlining City Procedures:** Committee members discussed and reviewed internal rules and processes governing how the city's elected officials conduct their business.
*   **Enhancing Public Engagement:** An update was provided on ongoing initiatives from the Public Engagement Task Force, aimed at improving citizen involvement with city government.
